lineages.boundary: Digital reference/annotation, not independent object collation.
New objects can expand discovery/critical comparison; preserve publication-specific readings and hypotheses.
Candidate/new Egyptian evidence must retain authenticity/classification qualifications.
Character inventory/transliteration proposals are scholarly models, not automatic canonical sign values.

rules: Do not count eDiAna and Nollé as independent readings.
Newly published objects remain separate from legacy numbering until explicit concordance.
Coins, manuscripts, graffiti and monumental inscriptions are distinct evidence classes.
Preserve competing transliterations/sign inventories rather than normalizing disagreement away.
